subject: AWS listing: regional usage scenarios, AMI footnote & copy review
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: AWS listing: regional usage scenarios, AMI footnote & copy review

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call earlier. We pulled together an initial draft of the AWS product page copy and a short set of regional usage scenarios to make the AMI / entitlement footnote clearer for customers. Attaching three files: draft-aws-listing-copy-v2.docx (our current hero + bullets), acme-usage-scenarios.pdf (customer-facing examples), and acme-ami-tags.csv (AMI/tag mapping we plan to publish).

As we discussed, two primary asks for today:
- Can you confirm the usage examples in the PDF are accurate for EU and APAC customers (data residency language)?
- Please review the AMI tag list and call out any internal partner SKUs that require different licensing language.

Kimberly — I flagged a couple of billing-footnote questions inline in the copy (see page 2). Jonas — want your opinion on the hero line; we want to balance speed claims vs. realistic throughput numbers for the Dedicated plan.

Next steps I'd like to lock by Monday: final hero, single-sentence privacy note for EU, and the AMI footnote with a link to the tag CSV. If we have those, I can push the offer to staging.

Thanks —
Olga
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft-aws-listing-copy-v2.docx (docx), acme-usage-scenarios.pdf (pdf), acme-ami-tags.csv (csv)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing: regional usage scenarios, AMI footnote & copy review

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the materials — reviewed the usage scenarios and the AMI tag list. A few quick notes inline below, and an updated usage PDF attached with tracked changes:

- EU data residency: we can confirm the three EU examples are accurate but want the privacy note to say: "Customer data either remains in the selected AWS region or is processed by Acme Analytics under EU data processing addendum." That keeps it short and audit-friendly.
- AMI tags: 2 of our partner SKUs (sku-acme-ml-pro and sku-acme-sec) require an additional footnote about a bring-your-own-license (BYOL) flow. See acme-ami-tags.csv line 42-43.
- Hero line suggestion: you can lead with a functional benefit rather than throughput. Proposed: "Low-latency LLM inference for analytics pipelines — optimized AMIs for high-throughput workloads". Avoid specific qps claims on the hero; move throughput example to the bullets.

I've attached acme-usage-scenarios_reviewed.pdf. Also looping in AWS Marketplace partner mailbox (aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com) to confirm the AMI tag format is acceptable for listing ingestion.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Head of Product, Acme Analytics

Attachment: acme-usage-scenarios_reviewed.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing: regional usage scenarios, AMI footnote & copy review

On Fri, 12 Jan 2028 at 09:18, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-analytics.com> wrote:
> - Hero line suggestion: you can lead with a functional benefit rather than throughput. Proposed: "Low-latency LLM inference for analytics pipelines — optimized AMIs for high-throughput workloads". Avoid specific qps claims on the hero; move throughput example to the bullets.

Sarah — thanks for the concrete suggestion, I agree. A few inline copy notes from my pass:

1) Hero: adopt Sarah's suggested phrasing but shorten to: "Low-latency LLM inference for analytics — optimized AMIs for high-throughput workloads."
2) Bullets: add one explicit example under "Throughput" showing: "~500 requests/min with 512-token avg prompt on Dedicated vCPU-backed plans" — label clearly as illustrative.
3) Billing footnote (page 2): call out privateoffer vs. on-demand pricing difference; language: "Charges reflect on-demand AMI usage; dedicated reserved pricing available via private offer."
4) AMI CSV: please rename header column "ami_tag" to "ami_id_or_tag" to match AWS ingestion schema. I've uploaded a short doc with these edits: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link

Jonas — can you confirm the throughput example is reasonable to include? If so, we should keep it as an illustrative number only and add a link to the performance bench in console.

Kim
Senior Manager, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-analytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing: regional usage scenarios, AMI footnote & copy review

Thanks all — quick alignment and next steps: 

- Sarah: we will adopt your EU privacy sentence verbatim and add the BYOL note for the two SKUs. I will mark lines 42-43 in the CSV as "BYOL" and include an internal comment for ingestion.
- Kim: please proceed with the hero edit and the billing footnote language you proposed. Jonas: if you can give a yes/no on the illustrative throughput by EOD tomorrow, I will lock final copy and push the listing to staging on Wednesday.

Action items assigned:
- Olga: update CSV header to ami_id_or_tag + flag BYOL SKUs; upload to the drive and ping aws-marketplace-partner. (target: 2028-01-16 12:00 PST)
- Kimberly: update draft-aws-listing-copy-v2.docx with hero + billing footnote edit and add the throughput bullet. (target: 2028-01-16 16:00 PST)
- Jonas: review throughput example and confirm or suggest adjustment. (target: 2028-01-16 18:00 PST)

I'll also create a HubSpot task on deal ACME-2028-135 and attach the updated assets. Thanks for the quick turnaround — this looks close.

Olga
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2028-135
Attachments referenced: acme-ami-tags.csv (updated pending)
